United Kingdom

The map covers four nations, nine English regions and 361 local authorities. December 2025 ONS boundaries contain Ordnance Survey data © Crown copyright and database right 2025. ONS boundaries

Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland each have a devolved legislature. The map shows ONS GDP at current market prices for 2024 and resident population estimates for 30 June 2025. Statistics for Barnsley and Sheffield use earlier boundaries, with the original codes shown on the map. UK government devolution guidance · ONS GDP · ONS population

Terrain and natural features

Elevation uses Mapzen 30-arc-second grids and six bands. Natural Earth provides rivers and lakes. Mapzen · Natural Earth

Universities and campuses

The atlas includes 195 institutions from the Office for Students register and a public university directory. Each institution is counted once per local authority. Campus locations come from OpenStreetMap and institutional sources, with some records placed by registered address. Filters cover the Russell Group, research degree-awarding powers in England and specialist institutions. OfS register · UK university directory

Railways and highways

The map includes high-speed, conventional passenger and freight lines, with nearby stations matched by distance to the tracks. Road geometry is generalised and follows motorway and major A-road records. Both layers use the 24 November 2026 OpenStreetMap snapshots. Great Britain data · Northern Ireland data · © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)

Airports and direct routes

The atlas includes 53 scheduled passenger airports grouped by 2025 terminal passenger totals. The CAA reports scheduled destinations for 41 of these airports. Check airline schedules for current service. UK Civil Aviation Authority, tables 09, 12.1 and 12.2

United States

The atlas covers 50 states, the District of Columbia and 3,144 counties and equivalents, including Louisiana parishes, Alaska boroughs and census areas, Connecticut planning regions and independent cities. All levels support English and Chinese names and FIPS searches. 2025 U.S. Census Bureau county and locality boundaries

States and counties use 2024 BEA GDP at current prices and midyear population. Separate BEA figures are available for 3,091 counties and equivalents. Seven newly mapped independent cities in Virginia use 2024 Census population estimates. Grey marks missing figures. BEA GDP · BEA population

Municipalities and townships

The third level covers about 32,000 incorporated places and county subdivisions with local government functions, plus 163 census-designated places in Hawaii. Incorporated villages and townships can overlap, so their populations should be read individually. Independent cities, coextensive city-counties and the District of Columbia are shown at county level. Census Bureau geographic terms

Municipalities across county lines show their mapped county parts, with both county-part and whole-place populations. Population uses 2025 midyear estimates, and Hawaii uses the 2020 decennial census for its statistical places. Comparable GDP is unavailable at this level. Census city and town population estimates · Hawaii decennial census data

Terrain and natural features

Elevation uses Mapzen grids. Natural Earth provides rivers and lakes. Selected labels include major ranges, rivers and lakes from the contiguous states, Alaska and Hawaii. Mapzen · Natural Earth

National parks

The atlas maps 61 national parks in the 50 states, including adjoining preserves for some parks. Select a park to open its National Park Service page. National Park Service

Universities and colleges

The 2024 IPEDS directory provides 2,745 eligible four-year degree-granting institutions, mapped by county or equivalent. Filters include public, private nonprofit, land-grant, historically Black and tribal institutions. IPEDS data centre

Railways and highways

Rail shows 49 Amtrak route records and 538 nearby station records. Highway geometry is generalised from 238 Interstate and 289 US Route numbers. BTS Amtrak routes · BTS National Highway System

Airports and direct routes

The map shows 634 scheduled passenger airports, with route records for 597. Routes are based on completed passenger traffic in BTS T-100 records from August 2025 through July 2026. Current service may vary. AirportMiles data sources · BTS aviation data

Place names and language

Use the language menu next to the country selector to switch between Chinese and the original language. Search accepts both names and administrative codes. Chinese labels use established names where available, with transliterations for some less common names. Identifiers such as IATA, ONS and FIPS codes are retained. GeoNames
